record.title: Pollen RPI Robot HAT — the unpublished custom PCB on the Radxa's 40-pin header: battery in, 5 V to the Radxa, servo-bus power + half-duplex DATA out, TLV320AIC3104 codec, dormant BMI088, Stemma J5 for the ToF

requires.name: GND
requires.cite: part:radxa-zero-3w header_40pin (pins 6/9/14/... on the 40-pin the HAT sits on)

requires.name: VBAT
requires.quote: In-robot power comes from the battery via the HAT regardless
requires.cite: research/raw/deploy_audio_i2c3-pihat.dts:22 (via docs/ELECTRONICS-AND-SOFTWARE.md §9); the 6.6–8.2 V window is model.rs:99-128, the runtime's own, read through the servos
requires.current_from_basis: The HAT's own draw (regulators, codec, transceiver) is unpublished — CANNOT DETERMINE. Not zero.

requires.name: UART2_TX
requires.quote: The debug serial port of ZERO 3 uses UART2_M0 (40-pin GPIO Pin 8: TX, Pin 10: RX)

requires.name: I2C3_SDA
requires.cite: part:radxa-zero-3w buses_the_microduck_uses.i2c3_m0_pins_3_5 ([brief] p.6); i2c3.dts GPIO1_A0 SDA

requires.name: I2S3_SCLK
requires.cite: part:radxa-zero-3w buses_the_microduck_uses.i2s3_m0 — M0 vs M1 mux CANNOT DETERMINE (both on the header)

requires.name: MCLK
requires.cite: part:radxa-zero-3w buses_the_microduck_uses.i2s3_m0 — 'a candidate origin for the overlay's 12 MHz fixed-clock (docs §7) — consistent, not proven'

provides.name: V5_OUT
provides.nominal_v_basis: 5 V is what the Radxa's 40-pin pins 2/4 accept ([brief] §5.1); that the HAT makes it from VBAT is the path docs §9 infers ('battery → banana contact PCB → HAT → 40-pin (5 V to Radxa)').
provides.capacity_basis: the HAT's regulator is unpublished — CANNOT DETERMINE (docs §9 'regulators on the HAT: CANNOT DETERMINE').
provides.quote: In-robot power comes from the battery via the HAT regardless

provides.name: SERVO_V
provides.nominal_v_basis: NULL ON PURPOSE. The servos read the pack (6.6–8.2 V) as their own supply (model.rs:99-113), which says the bus VDD is the pack passed through, not a regulated rail — an inference from code, and stock XL330s are rated 3.7–6.0 V (part:xl330-m288-t supplies[0]). Whether it is the raw pack, a regulated bus or a custom servo is docs §3.4 open question 1.
provides.capacity_basis: no fuse, switch or regulator figure is published.
provides.quote: the runtime reads the pack voltage as the servos' own supply

provides.name: DXL_DATA
provides.quote: no direction GPIO anywhere in the code -> self-steering half-duplex circuit, assumed on the HAT
provides.cite: docs/ELECTRONICS-AND-SOFTWARE.md §3.1 ([C-elec], community inference); reference layout part:xl330-m288-t communication_circuit (74LVC2G241) — the fitted transceiver is CANNOT DETERMINE

provides.name: J5_3V3
provides.nominal_v_basis: the ToF's IOVDD/AVDD 3.3 V configuration (part:vl53l5cx supplies) on the HAT's 'Stemma J5' (i2c3.dts:10); whether J5's 3.3 V is the Radxa's pin-1 3.3 V passed through or a HAT regulator is CANNOT DETERMINE.

provides.name: SPK+
provides.cite: docs/ELECTRONICS-AND-SOFTWARE.md §7 — community; whether an amplifier sits between the codec (HPLOUT/LEFT_LOP, part:tlv320aic3104 pinout) and the speaker is CANNOT DETERMINE

provides.name: MIC_IN
provides.cite: docs/ELECTRONICS-AND-SOFTWARE.md §7 — community; the codec's MIC2R/LINE2R is pin 16 (part:tlv320aic3104 pinout)

provides.name: MICBIAS
provides.nominal_v_basis: the TLV320AIC3104 MICBIAS pin 15 (part:tlv320aic3104 pinout) — programmable 2.0 / 2.5 V / AVDD per TI; which is set, and whether the fitted mic uses it at all, is CANNOT DETERMINE.

uncertainties: The PCB is not published (docs §11 open question 4). Connector types on the HAT (servo header, J5, battery input, speaker/mic) are CANNOT DETERMINE; every position used by the wiring lane is the HAT mesh's placement origin.
Transceiver, regulators, fusing, NFC reader, REC LED: CANNOT DETERMINE (docs §12 items 4, 8, 11).
I2S3 mux M0 (pins 12/13/35/38/40) vs M1 (19/21/23/24): the dts pinctrl was not read — the M0 pins are the wiring lane's assertion, stated as one.
record.note: The one board every cable in the head lands on. Modelled as a part that NEEDS the Radxa's pins and the battery and PROVIDES the servo bus, the ToF's J5 rail, the Radxa's 5 V and the audio terminals — the regulator pattern in cecad.netlist.wire(): a provision named in the mapping joins the net as its source.
record.written: 2026-09-02, wiring lane (GOAL.md rung 5). Every figure names the document it came from; a figure with no document is null and says so.
